# ASTER DA MASTER — artist archive (llms.txt)

Private research archive for the underground artist **Aster da Master** (digicore/hyperpop orbit, scene tag "somelowlifes"). Static site + JSON API.

**Catalog:** 219 transmissions total — 34 distributor releases (9 albums, 25 singles, verified via Apple Music/iTunes Search API) + 185 SoundCloud-only tracks (read-only capture 2026-10-11, play counts are a snapshot).
**Collaborators:** 21 title-credited collaborators, each with a `circle/` page. Producers are excluded by the circle's title-credit rule; documented producer/scene figures live under `circle/` "Beyond the circle" (e.g. `circle/fish-narc.html`).
**Codex:** 16 vocabulary families counted across titles (`codex/`), each with a full deep-dive page (`codex/<slug>.html`: decoded reading, era-by-era evolution, key sessions, collaborators).
**Sessions:** 61 upload sessions clustered from vault upload dates (`sessions/`, `api/v1/sessions.json`); the explorable timeline (`sessions-explorer.html`, `api/v1/session-clusters.json`): 9 activity seasons, 60 inter-session gaps (553-day longest silence), per-session loudest + deepest-cut tracks, era/year filters.
**Method:** titles and metadata only — no lyrics ever, no invented biography. Unknowns are listed as unknowns (`method.html` → "The unknowns register").

**API:** all data at `api/v1/*.json` — `artist.json`, `circle.json`, `scene-figures.json`, `codex.json`, `milestones.json`, `milestone-watch.json`, `sessions.json`, `session-clusters.json` (session archaeology, interactive: 61 enriched sessions, 60 gaps, 9 activity seasons, asserted insights; drives `sessions-explorer.html`), `transmission.json` (six era aggregates for the guided journey; the 2026 era carries an `extras` block: the four verified 2026 singles, the Q4 2026 Uncle-LP/trilogy watch, the play-count snapshot), `eras.json` (era deep-dives: full transmission lists, all in-era collaborators, active codex families, computed signal summaries), `network.json` (collaboration graph: nodes/edges/insights), `codex-families.json` (codex family deep-dives: decoded readings, era evolution, key sessions, collaborators; drives `codex/<slug>.html`), `milestone-races.json` (the milestone race: 4 approaching play-count races ranked by gap-closing proximity, the 30,088-play summit chase, session + era records, just-crossed milestones — pace arithmetic, never predictions; drives `milestone-race.html`), `release-slugs.json`, `on-this-day.json`, `first-last.json`, `index.json` (endpoint registry, `version` field). Data version: 0.14.0.

**Pages:** `transmission.html` — the flagship guided journey: six eras (2018→2026) plus three live data chapters (The Race + The Record Book, driven by `milestone-races.json`; The Codex, driven by `codex-families.json` — no figures hardcoded): per-era transmissions/plays/sessions, 3 defining tracks, key sessions, collaborators, milestones, a computed "signal" line, and the 2026 era's verified-singles + Q4-watch extras; step-through with keyboard arrows, optional 12s auto-play (disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`), journey map with visited stops, resume-from-last-stop, share-a-stop deep links (`transmission.html#era-<id>` / `#chapter-<id>`), and "Copy my transmission" share text. `network.html` — the collaboration universe as an interactive SVG graph: 21 title-credited collaborators (node size = shared tracks) + producer scene figures (squares), track-weighted edges, co-credit edges from shared titles, drag nodes, era slider (2018–2026 highlight), producers toggle, name search, click-a-node side panel (tracks together, first/last, circle-page link); the same data as an accessible table, plus computed insights (most frequent collaborator, producer with most credits, busiest collab year, first-ever collaborator). Data: `api/v1/network.json` (generated by `scripts/build_network.py`). Plus `eras/` — six era deep-dive pages (full track lists with plays, every in-era collaborator, active codex families, computed signal summaries), each linking back to its Transmission journey node (`transmission.html#era-<id>`); data: `api/v1/eras.json` (generated by `scripts/build_eras.py`). Plus `sessions-explorer.html` — the 61 upload sessions as an explorable timeline: 9 activity seasons, the 60 inter-session gaps with the 553-day silence, the 19-track Nov 3–12 2023 most-prolific session, per-session deepest cuts, era/year filters; data: `api/v1/session-clusters.json` (generated by `scripts/build_session_clusters.py`). Plus `milestone-race.html` — the milestone race: approaching play-count milestones ranked by gap-closing proximity, the 30,088-play summit chase, session + era records, the most recently crossed milestones (pace arithmetic, never predictions); data: `api/v1/milestone-races.json` (generated by `scripts/build_milestone_races.py`, last in the chain).

**For agents:** `AGENT.md` is the operator's manual (base URL pattern, key endpoints with example requests, 7 end-to-end workflows: SomeLowLifes era brief, 10 quietest deep cuts, Max Ferrari collab trace, era deep dive, sessions timeline, codex family trace, milestone race). `agents.html` documents the full agentic surface (19-endpoint table, llms files, skills, search-index usage, rate/expectation notes, 5 worked writeups). `api-playground.html` has an Explore tab (live endpoint responses) and a Skill recipes tab. `skills/`: 10 archive-analysis playbooks (Use when / Inputs / Procedure / Worked example / API references / Pitfalls) — `deep-cuts-finder`, `session-archaeology`, `session-explorer`, `collaborator-tracer`, `network-graph-reader`, `milestone-watcher`, `era-briefing`, `transmission-decoder`, `codex-reader`, `milestone-race-reader` — plus `announce-release`, `build-press-kit`, `verify-platform-links` (registry: `skills/index.json`, 13 skills). `api/v1/index.json` is the self-describing manifest: every endpoint with description, schema URL (`api/v1/schema/*.json`, all 19 validating), `updated` timestamp, record counts, deprecation notes. Rules for agents: static JSON, no auth; play counts are a 2026-10-11 snapshot (always state the date); upload dates ≠ recording dates; titles/metadata only, never lyrics, never invent bio facts.

**Key research facts (2026-10-11 pass, sources cited on-site):**
- Earliest indexed track "Protections" (Dec 23, 2019, label "WoT", on album *Master Key*); albums *Cast It:, Pt. 1* (2021), *Cast It:, Pt. 2* (2022); single "Reachhh" (Apr 8, 2024, label "somelowlifes"); 2026 singles "The Night Ends Yeaaa" (Mar), "Writing Books" / "9 Trips" / "Living With The Big Shots" (May).
- capoxxo: named in Pitchfork's "A Deeply Incomplete Canon of Hyperpop-Digicore"; collab tape *Persona* w/ mayh3mp (Cult Love Sound Tapes, 2022); tracks "candy", "getting colder".
- pvscale: produced "fly like me"; co-produced "getting colder" w/ asa41; also produces for capoxxo, lil koi, lil yu.
- Fish Narc (b. 1992, Seattle/Olympia; GothBoiClique; produced Lil Peep's *Goth Angel Sinner*; *frog song* LP 2025, K Records) — producer credit on "Pavement" and "Soul Shaking".
- Best SomeLowLifes network evidence: May 15, 2020 Internet Phantoms podcast episode (2 unnamed members; playlist links Lil' Spursy, DirtyDoves, Offline HP, Aster Da Master, producer Lil' Flower) — evidence, not roster.
- Could not be verified: SomeLowLifes member roster; "litemode / nitemode" meaning; public profiles for Max Ferrari, Yung Vetta, Lil Yu, JAX, YungSkah, AWFL, shinju, odece, lil biscuit, wetgropes, Born Hero.

**Generators:** `scripts/build_*.py` rebuild all derived pages from `data/artist.json`; dependency order: releases → years → circle → codex → sessions → session_deepdives → milestones → milestone_watch → firstlast → glance → search_index → changelog → transmission → network → eras → session_clusters → codex_pages → milestone_races. Re-running sets data version in all JSON.

Repo: private GitHub-only (astercast/aster-da-master), no Vercel. Deploy: any static host serving the repo root; weekly SoundCloud play-count refresh pipeline documented in GO_LIVE.md.
